product_overview: Postora is a social media management backend built on Supabase Edge Functions and a self-hosted gateway. It supports OAuth account linking, content creation and scheduling, media and AI utilities, billing, admin observability, and public automation APIs.
core_goals: Expose all discoverable backend endpoints through a consistent Supabase Edge Function gateway.
Validate authentication, authorization, and request payload handling across public, protected, admin, cron, and webhook routes.
Support social account OAuth connections and managed redirects for multiple provider platforms.
Enable media upload, transformation, AI generation, and content scheduling workflows for social publishing.
Provide a public n8n-compatible automation API for profiles, accounts, media upload, post creation, scheduling, and post status tracking.
Support billing, subscription lifecycle, account security, and administrative observability operations with safe failure behavior.

features.name: Supabase Edge Function Gateway
features.description: Provides the shared edge-function entrypoint, CORS handling, and public configuration exposure for the backend.
user_flows: OPTIONS /functions/v1/* on any edge function -> Receive 200 with CORS headers -> Browser/client may proceed with authorized request
POST /functions/v1/get-public-config without authentication -> Receive 200 with public config object
GET /functions/v1/unsplash-proxy without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: OAuth Connection APIs
features.description: Lets authenticated users generate OAuth URLs, complete provider callbacks, and manage connected social accounts across supported platforms.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/facebook-oauth with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and body {"action":"generate-url"} -> Receive 200 with OAuth action result -> User completes provider authorization -> POST /functions/v1/facebook-oauth with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and body {"action":"exchange-code"} -> Receive 200 with connected account result
POST /functions/v1/instagram-oauth with invalid or missing Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /functions/v1/manage-oauth-redirects with Authorization Bearer <non-admin JWT> -> Receive 403 Admin only
POST /functions/v1/twitter-oauth with malformed JSON body -> Receive client error for invalid request payload

features.name: Public n8n API
features.description: Exposes a Bearer-key protected REST API for automation workflows to inspect profiles, accounts, media, posts, and post status.
user_flows: GET /functions/v1/n8n-api/api/v1/profiles with Authorization Bearer <profiles.api_key> -> Receive 200 with profiles list and usage
POST /functions/v1/n8n-api/api/v1/upload-media with Authorization Bearer <profiles.api_key> and valid upload payload -> Receive 200 with uploaded media ids and usage
POST /functions/v1/n8n-api/api/v1/create-post with Authorization Bearer <profiles.api_key> and valid post payload -> Receive 200 with created post object and usage
GET /functions/v1/n8n-api/api/v1/post-status/:id with Authorization Bearer <profiles.api_key> for unknown id -> Receive 404 Post not found
GET /functions/v1/n8n-api/api/v1/accounts with missing or invalid API key -> Receive 401 Invalid API key
POST /functions/v1/n8n-api/api/v1/upload-media with invalid payload structure -> Receive 400 Invalid upload payload
GET /functions/v1/n8n-api/api/v1/unknown-route with Authorization Bearer <profiles.api_key> -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Posting And Scheduling Pipeline
features.description: Processes immediate and scheduled publishing tasks for social content, blog posts, feature flags, and scheduled emails.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/process-post with service/authorized credentials and a queued post identifier -> Receive 200 with per-platform publish results
POST /functions/v1/process-scheduled-posts with cron secret -> Receive 200 with processing summary for due posts
POST /functions/v1/process-post without required authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /functions/v1/process-scheduled-posts with malformed cron authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Media APIs
features.description: Handles Cloudinary-backed media operations, video processing, image transformation, cleanup, and copyright checks.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/cloudinary-upload with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid media payload -> Receive 200 with uploaded asset metadata
POST /functions/v1/remove-background with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid image reference -> Receive 200 with transformed image result
POST /functions/v1/check-music-copyright with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and media metadata -> Receive 200 with copyright check result
POST /functions/v1/cloudinary-delete with missing Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /functions/v1/cloudinary-upload with malformed JSON or missing required fields -> Receive client error
POST /functions/v1/upscale-image with unsupported or incomplete payload -> Receive client error or validation failure

features.name: AI Generation APIs
features.description: Provides AI-driven caption, hashtag, image, and posting-time suggestions, plus admin configuration and model catalog access.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/generate-caption with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid prompt -> Receive 200 with caption generation result and credit debit
POST /functions/v1/generate-hashtags with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid context -> Receive 200 with hashtag generation result
POST /functions/v1/generate-image with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid prompt -> Receive 200 with image generation result
POST /functions/v1/suggest-best-times with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and account context -> Receive 200 with best-time suggestions
GET /functions/v1/openrouter-models with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> -> Receive 200 with model list
POST /functions/v1/ai-config with Authorization Bearer <non-admin JWT> -> Receive 403 Admin only
POST /functions/v1/generate-caption with malformed JSON body -> Receive client error for invalid request payload

features.name: Webhooks
features.description: Accepts public webhook callbacks and verification challenges while validating signatures, tokens, or platform secrets before state changes.
user_flows: GET /functions/v1/whatsapp-webhook with verification challenge parameters -> Receive 200 with verification challenge response
POST /functions/v1/stripe-webhook with valid signature headers and event payload -> Receive 200 Webhook accepted
POST /functions/v1/resend-webhook with valid delivery event payload -> Receive 200 Webhook accepted
POST /functions/v1/tiktok-webhook with valid signed event payload -> Receive 200 Webhook accepted
POST /functions/v1/stripe-webhook with invalid signature -> Receive 400 Signature or payload error
POST /functions/v1/whatsapp-webhook with invalid verification token or malformed payload -> Receive client error or rejection without state mutation

features.name: Billing And Subscription APIs
features.description: Supports Stripe checkout, subscription management, one-off payments, payment verification, and subscription synchronization.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/stripe-checkout with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid checkout request -> Receive 200 with checkout session URL
POST /functions/v1/stripe-manage-subscription with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> -> Receive 200 with subscription management result
POST /functions/v1/create-payment with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid amount/currency -> Receive 200 with payment intent result
POST /functions/v1/verify-payment with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid checkout/session reference -> Receive 200 with verification result
POST /functions/v1/check-subscription with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> -> Receive 200 with subscription status
POST /functions/v1/stripe-checkout with missing Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /functions/v1/create-payment with malformed payload -> Receive client error

features.name: Admin Operations And Observability
features.description: Allows admin users to manage secrets, cron jobs, alerting, health collection, and quota synchronization.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/manage-app-secrets with Authorization Bearer <admin JWT> -> Receive 200 with secret management result
POST /functions/v1/manage-cron-jobs with Authorization Bearer <admin JWT> -> Receive 200 with cron management result
POST /functions/v1/observability-collector with Authorization Bearer <admin JWT> -> Receive 200 with health collection result
POST /functions/v1/sync-user-quotas with Authorization Bearer <admin JWT> -> Receive 200 with quota sync result
POST /functions/v1/manage-app-secrets with Authorization Bearer <non-admin JWT> -> Receive 403 Admin only
POST /functions/v1/manage-cron-jobs with missing or invalid credentials -> Receive authorization failure

features.name: Account Security APIs
features.description: Supports MFA inspection, password reset OTP flows, MFA reset verification, password changes, and backup code management.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/check-user-mfa with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> -> Receive 200 with MFA factor status
POST /functions/v1/send-reset-otp with valid email payload -> Receive 200 with OTP send result
POST /functions/v1/verify-reset-otp with valid email and OTP -> Receive 200 with OTP verification result
POST /functions/v1/verify-mfa-reset with valid OTP and reset payload -> Receive 200 with MFA reset verification result
POST /functions/v1/change-password with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> and valid password payload -> Receive 200 with password change result
POST /functions/v1/manage-backup-codes with Authorization Bearer <Supabase JWT> -> Receive 200 with backup code action result
POST /functions/v1/send-reset-otp with missing or malformed email payload -> Receive client error without exposing account enumeration
POST /functions/v1/change-password with missing Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

known_limitations.issue: Most endpoints require real Supabase JWTs, admin roles, API keys, cron secrets, webhook signatures, or third-party provider credentials, so unauthenticated black-box tests can only assert security boundaries and public endpoints.
known_limitations.impact: Full happy-path backend testing needs seeded local auth users, API keys, database rows, and external API test credentials.

known_limitations.issue: The repository does not include a committed TestSprite configuration yet.
known_limitations.impact: First TestSprite run must bootstrap configuration before execution.

known_limitations.issue: Local Supabase ports are not declared in supabase/config.toml.
known_limitations.impact: Local tests assume the Supabase CLI default API port 54321 unless a running service reports otherwise.
